title: Hangman Challenge 2
description: Hangman Challenge 2 challenges you and you need to win, and to do this, guess the words, targets or letters and do not let the gallows appear. At the top you will see the topic in which the word is given, this will greatly facilitate your task. If the theme is animals, then there will definitely not be roses, tables or other objects.
instructions: Use mouse on desktop or touch on your mobile device
